description: 100 most used irregular verb conjugations for casual conversation

cards.question: Faço
cards.explanation: Eu faço isso depois. (I'll do this later.)

cards.question: Faz
cards.explanation: Você faz muita falta! (You are greatly missed!)

cards.question: Fiz
cards.explanation: Fiz o que deu. (I did what I could.)

cards.question: Fez
cards.explanation: Ele fez de propósito. (He did it on purpose.)

cards.question: Digo
cards.explanation: O que eu digo pra ela? (What do I say to her?)

cards.question: Diz
cards.explanation: Diz que sim! (Say yes!)

cards.question: Disse
cards.explanation: Eu já disse isso. (I already said that.)

cards.question: Posso
cards.explanation: Posso entrar? (Can I come in?)

cards.question: Pode
cards.explanation: Pode deixar! (Leave it to me / No problem!)

cards.question: Pude
cards.answer: I could / I was able to
cards.explanation: Não pude ir ontem. (I couldn't go yesterday.)

cards.question: Pôde
cards.explanation: Ele não pôde avisar. (He couldn't let [us] know.)

cards.question: Sei
cards.explanation: Não sei de nada. (I don't know anything.)

cards.question: Sabe

cards.question: Soube

cards.question: Vejo
cards.explanation: Te vejo lá! (See you there!)

cards.question: Vê
cards.explanation: Vê se não esquece! (Make sure you don't forget!)

cards.question: Viu
cards.explanation: Viu o que aconteceu? (Did you see what happened?)

cards.question: Venho
cards.explanation: Venho aqui sempre. (I come here all the time.)

cards.question: Vem
cards.explanation: Vem cá rapidão. (Come here real quick.)

cards.question: Veio
cards.explanation: Ninguém veio hoje. (Nobody came today.)

cards.question: Tenho
cards.explanation: Tenho que ir. (I have to go.)

cards.question: Tem
cards.answer: You have / He-She has / There is
cards.explanation: Tem café aí? (Is there any coffee there?)

cards.question: Teve
cards.explanation: Ele teve sorte. (He was lucky.)

cards.question: Sou
cards.explanation: Sou eu! (It's me!)

cards.question: É
cards.explanation: É sério isso? (Is that serious?)

cards.question: São
cards.explanation: São quase dez horas. (It's almost ten o'clock.)

cards.question: Foi
cards.explanation: Foi mal! (My bad!)

cards.question: Fui
cards.explanation: Fui eu que fiz. (It was me who did it.)

cards.question: Estou
cards.explanation: Estou chegando! (I'm arriving!)

cards.question: Tá
cards.explanation: Tá tudo bem? (Is everything okay?)

cards.question: Tava
cards.explanation: Eu tava dormindo. (I was sleeping.)

cards.question: Tão
cards.explanation: Onde eles tão? (Where are they?)

cards.question: Vou
cards.explanation: Vou sair agora. (I'm going out now.)

cards.question: Vai
cards.explanation: Vai dar certo! (It's going to work!)

cards.question: Quero
cards.explanation: Quero nem saber! (I don't even want to know!)

cards.question: Quer
cards.explanation: Quer ajuda? (Want help?)

cards.question: Quis
cards.explanation: Ele não quis vir. (He didn't want to come.)

cards.question: Dou
cards.explanation: Te dou um toque. (I'll give you a call/ping.)

cards.question: Dá
cards.explanation: Dá pra ver daqui. (It's possible to see from here.)

cards.question: Deu
cards.explanation: Deu tudo certo! (Everything worked out!)

cards.question: Trago
cards.explanation: Trago as brejas. (I'll bring the beers.)

cards.question: Traz
cards.explanation: Traz pra mim, por favor. (Bring it to me, please.)

cards.question: Trouxe
cards.explanation: Trouxe o que você pediu. (I brought what you asked for.)

cards.question: Ponho
cards.explanation: Onde eu ponho isso? (Where do I put this?)

cards.question: Põe
cards.explanation: Põe em cima da mesa. (Put it on the table.)

cards.question: Pôs
cards.explanation: Quem pôs isso aqui? (Who put this here?)

cards.question: Peço
cards.explanation: Peço uma pizza? (Should I order a pizza?)

cards.question: Pede
cards.explanation: Ele pede demais. (He asks too much.)

cards.question: Pediu
cards.explanation: Pediu pra avisar. (He asked to let [you] know.)

cards.question: Ouço
cards.explanation: Não ouço nada. (I can't hear anything.)

cards.question: Ouve
cards.explanation: Ouve o que eu tô dizendo. (Listen to what I'm saying.)

cards.question: Ouviu
cards.explanation: Você ouviu isso? (Did you hear that?)

cards.question: Perco
cards.explanation: Não perco por nada! (I won't miss it for anything!)

cards.question: Perde
cards.explanation: Cuidado pra não perder. (Careful not to lose [it].)

cards.question: Perdeu
cards.explanation: Perdeu a hora? (Did you miss the time / oversleep?)

cards.question: Saio
cards.explanation: Saio do trampo às seis. (I leave work at six.)

cards.question: Sai
cards.explanation: Sai daqui logo! (Get out of here now!)

cards.question: Saiu
cards.explanation: Ela já saiu. (She already left.)

cards.question: Rio
cards.explanation: Eu rio de tudo. (I laugh at everything.)

cards.question: Ri
cards.explanation: Ele ri à toa. (He laughs for no reason.)

cards.question: Riu
cards.explanation: Ninguém riu da piada. (Nobody laughed at the joke.)

cards.question: Vale
cards.explanation: Valeu a pena! (It was worth it!)

cards.question: Valho
cards.explanation: Eu valho muito mais. (I am worth much more.)

cards.question: Valeu
cards.explanation: Valeu, abraço! (Thanks, bye!)

cards.question: Cabe
cards.explanation: Não cabe mais nada. (Nothing else fits.)

cards.question: Coube
cards.explanation: Coube certinho! (It fitted perfectly!)

cards.question: Meço
cards.explanation: Eu meço dois metros. (I measure two meters.)

cards.question: Mede
cards.explanation: Mede aí pra mim. (Measure [it] there for me.)

cards.question: Mediu
cards.explanation: Ele mediu errado. (He measured it wrong.)

cards.question: Leio
cards.explanation: Eu leio no ônibus. (I read on the bus.)

cards.question: Lê
cards.explanation: Você lê rápido? (Do you read fast?)

cards.question: Leu
cards.explanation: Leu o Whats? (Did you read the WhatsApp [message]?)

cards.question: Creio
cards.explanation: Creio que sim. (I believe so.)

cards.question: Crê
cards.explanation: Ninguém crê nisso. (Nobody believes in that.)

cards.question: Veem
cards.explanation: Eles não veem a hora. (They can't wait.)

cards.question: Vêm
cards.explanation: Quando eles vêm? (When are they coming?)

cards.question: Têm
cards.explanation: Eles têm razão. (They are right.)

cards.question: Lemos
cards.explanation: Lemos isso ontem. (We read this yesterday.)

cards.question: Fazemos
cards.explanation: O que fazemos agora? (What do we do now?)

cards.question: Pudemos
cards.explanation: Pudemos ajudar. (We were able to help.)

cards.question: Tive
cards.explanation: Tive um problema. (I had a problem.)

cards.question: Estive
cards.explanation: Estive lá semana passada. (I was there last week.)

cards.question: Houve
cards.explanation: Houve um erro. (There was an error.)

cards.question: Trarei
cards.explanation: Trarei amanhã sem falta. (I'll bring it tomorrow without fail.)

cards.question: Direi
cards.explanation: Não direi nada. (I won't say anything.)

cards.question: Farão
cards.explanation: O que eles farão? (What will they do?)

cards.question: Poderia
cards.explanation: Poderia me ajudar? (Could you help me?)

cards.question: Gostaria
cards.explanation: Gostaria de um café. (I would like a coffee.)

cards.question: Soubermos
cards.explanation: Se soubermos, avisamos. (If we find out, we'll let [you] know.)

cards.question: Vier
cards.explanation: Se ele vier, eu saio. (If he comes, I leave.)

cards.question: Fizer
cards.explanation: Se você fizer isso, morre. (If you do that, you die.)

cards.question: Puder
cards.explanation: Quando eu puder, eu vou. (When I can, I'll go.)

cards.question: Quiser
cards.explanation: Se você quiser, eu topo. (If you want, I'm down.)

cards.question: Der
cards.explanation: Se der, eu apareço. (If possible, I'll show up.)

cards.question: Virmos
cards.explanation: Se o virmos, falamos. (If we see him, we'll talk.)

cards.question: Dissermos
cards.explanation: Se dissermos a verdade... (If we tell the truth...)

cards.question: Trouxerem
cards.explanation: Se eles trouxerem comida... (If they bring food...)

cards.question: Puserem
cards.explanation: Se puserem aqui, quebra. (If they put [it] here, it breaks.)

cards.question: Tiverem
cards.explanation: Se as meninas tiverem lá... (If the girls are there...)

cards.question: Quiserem
cards.explanation: Se eles quiserem vir, pode. (If they want to come, they can.)
